product_metadata.title: Window Seal for Air Conditioner with 2 in 1 Coupler, Upgraded Portable AC Replacement Sliding Window Kit, Adjustable Length Panels for Air Conditioner Exhaust Vent Hose of 5.1"/5.9" Diameter
features: 【2022 Upgraded Version】The newest ac window vent kit can support both 5.1” and 5.9” ac exhaust hose, applying to most portable air conditioner. The upgraded ac window plates fit your window better, you needn’t buy extra tapes to make it seamless. It effectively diffuse the hot air out of the window and preventing warm air circulating in your room to keep your room cool and save electricity charges meanwhile.

【Wide Compatibility】Portable air conditioner window vent kit consists of 3 plates, 17inch long for each.The adjustable range from 24.8” to 47”, suit for horizontal or vertical windows with a length of 24.8-47”. works for all portable air conditioners exhaust hose with a diameter of 5.1”/5.9”, compatible with Midea/LG/ Hisense/BLACK+BECKE/Whynter/Honeywell/Newair/FRIGIDAIRE/Emerson/Shinco/Gree/ Aux/Haier, etc.

【Durable Material】AGPTEK air conditioner window kit is made of high quality PVC board, which is portable and light weight. The portable ac window kit is easy to clean, install and disassemble. You can easily move the plates from one window to another to reuse without extra tool, very convenient, perfectly suit for both home and office use.

【Easy to Install and Disassemble】 Our window slide kit adopted novel design, no additional tools needed, very easy to set up and detach to restore, Besides, the installation video is attached, no worry about installation.

【What You Will Get】Window Kit PVC adjustable Plate*1, Window Kit PVC Fixed Plate*2, Screws Set*3, Coupler*1. One-year quality guarantee and lifetime technical support. Kindly Note: Please measure the window size before buying. (Exhaust Hose is Not Included)
